agent.description: Activated agent ID from ListCodingAgents; use that tool to discover credential kinds, capabilities, endpoints and supported driver options.

include_unavailable.description: Include disabled, unsupported and cooling-down accounts for administration. Omit for task-eligible accounts only.

limit.description: Maximum results per page, 1–100. Discovery tools default to 25. Follow next_offset with offset to continue.

offset.description: Zero-based discovery offset; use the preceding response next_offset to continue (maximum 1000000).
